title: Thai Northern Chicken Boat Noodle Soup
description: A comforting and flavorful Thai-inspired noodle soup made with tender chicken and soft noodles. This hearty dish is perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: thai red curry paste
ingredients.notes: make sure to choose a gluten-free option

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pot and set aside.
Add the curry paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Add the broth, fish sauce (if using), and the browned chicken back to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and let simmer for 10-12 minutes.
Cook the noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
Add the cooked noodles to the pot and stir to combine.
Serve hot, garnished with sliced pepper and a sprinkle of pepper, if desired.
